title: Stratton forms the UAP Task Force

tellings.quote: I think Stratton was former Navy maybe as well and he formed the whole UAP task force which was basically like let's internally review all of the data here.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named Jay Stratton, who he thinks may have been in the Navy, formed the UAP Task Force around 2020. UAP stands for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs, and Michels describes the task force as a group set up to review all the government's data on them internally. He tells it as a step in the US government taking these reports seriously.
